arrivals.unit: one origin market in one month

columns.arrivals: the board's estimate of visitors who arrived

tickets.unit: one ticket sale at one site

columns.tickets: tickets in the sale, which is the number of visitors

stays.unit: one visiting party's stay in the region

columns.stay_id: pseudonymised key of the stay, never a name
columns.purpose: leisure, family visit, business or event
columns.nights: nights spent in the region; 0 is a day visit
columns.accommodation: hotel, apartment, with family, camp or none
columns.spend_sar: what the party said it spent in the region, riyals
columns.booking_lead_days: days between booking and arrival; 0 is no booking
columns.age_band: age band of the person who answered

survey.unit: one visitor's response after a site visit

columns.language: language of the response, ar or en
columns.guided: 1 when the visit was a guided one
columns.comment: a short free-text comment, often empty

complaints.unit: one complaint logged by the visitor experience team

columns.category: queue, cleanliness, price, signage, staff or access
